title: Among all transactions that occurred in the morning (before 13:00) on Augus
question: Among all transactions that occurred in the morning (before 13:00) on August 26, 2012, at gas stations in the Czech Republic and were paid in CZK, determine the top 5 best-selling products by total quantity sold. Return only the product descriptions.
